caseNameFull: Honig, California Superintendent of Public Instruction v. Doe

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 479 U. S. 1084.] Motion of Davis Joint Unified School District et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
